computational_consequences.inert_prime_filter: for a Hecke trace polynomial P, residual compatibility at an inert rational prime requires gcd(P mod p, X^p-X) to have positive degree
computational_consequences.split_prime_filter_fixed7: at two conjugate primes impose T_sigma-T^7
computational_consequences.split_prime_filter_mod5: at three conjugate primes impose T_sigma-T^5 and T_sigma2-T^25 on the same residual eigensystem
computational_consequences.target_application: apply the inert-prime tests at 13 and 43 to fixed-7 packets 24 and 28, and add inert mod-5 primes to the residual Hecke-module sieve

nonclaim: the semilinear descent from the Q-defined realization and the modular identification are imported motive-theoretic inputs; the finite-field, splitting and polynomial consequences are independently replayable and do not by themselves prove (3,5,7)

source_dependencies.galois_action: Golfieri--Pacetti arXiv:2412.08804v2, equation (16): coefficient conjugation sends H((a,b),(c,d)|t) to H((ja,jb),(jc,jd)|t) for rational t
source_dependencies.modularity: the two residual systems are identified with Hilbert-newform Galois representations after the existing irreducibility and level-lowering inputs
source_dependencies.rational_realization: the relevant rank-two constituents occur in the new part of a hyperelliptic curve defined over Q, with real multiplication by the indicated coefficient field

fixed7.inert_prime_scalar_condition: if the prime of K5 is fixed by Gal(K5/Q), then a_l^7=a_l, hence a_l lies in F7

mod5.inert_prime_scalar_condition: if the prime of K7 is fixed by Gal(K7/Q), then a_l^5=a_l, hence a_l lies in F5
